coverage: Sacramento County candidate basics include all61 complete OnBallotYes local office blocks in the current official county roster. Two shared college trustee-area1 fields (6 candidates) have actual official sample proof; the remaining59 fields are clearly labeled official candidate-list supplements (162 qualified names), with actual sample acquisition still pending. Seven held Third District appellate retention questions are separately reverified on official samples.

The current official roster contains61 OnBallotYes local fields and62 No/Off local fields. The earlier strict parser undercounted headings containing nonbreaking spaces, compact dashes or double spaces; this corrected inventory splits every office at its complete Contest header. No qualified name is carried across an office boundary.

Candidate qualification evidence is the current official candidate list for59 fields and actual official samples for2 fields. The53-field sample gap reported before robust header parsing is corrected to59 sample fields; no roster is called a sample. No inference of cancellation, appointment, election absence or outcome is made from No/Off flags. No ordinary candidate is created from DID NOT FILE, DID NOT QUALIFY, Pending or WITHDRAWN rows.

Sacramento guide lookup requires date of birth; no voter identity or DOB submitted. Official county certification says there are no certified write-in candidates, preserved separately. Exact trustee areas, supervisor/council districts, utility ward and special-district divisions are retained; no electorate is widened to a whole city, school district or county. Unrelated statewide, legislative and measure records/explanations remain unchanged.
